source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: A unit can make an Assault Disembark Move only when another rule grants this move type, and only if all of these are true: it is aboard a TRANSPORT model currently on the battlefield; it did not board that TRANSPORT during this phase; and that TRANSPORT has not advanced or fallen back during this phase. The unit is placed by the Set Up procedure (03.02 in the Core Rules), with every model wholly within 3" of that TRANSPORT.

detail.grantedBy: another rule naming this move type

all: embarked within a TRANSPORT model on the battlefield
did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase
that TRANSPORT made no advance move this phase
that TRANSPORT made no fall-back move this phase
